messages:
nina_pm: Heads up 1: OptiHealth is asking for a self-serve dashboard that ties cost per feature to error trends and SLO breaches. They want a single-pane view for finance + SRE. Can we agree on scope for an MVP?

rajeev: Key ask sounds like three things: cost attribution by feature, error/latency correlation, and an export/report for finance. We should be explicit about what 'feature' maps to (route, customer flag, or service).

cassie_ui: UX recommendation: don't overload the first screen. MVP should show feature selector (free-text + examples), a stacked chart of cost components, and a separate error-trend sparkline with drill-to-traces.

omar_se: Engineering note: mapping feature->route isn't trivial. Some customers use multiple routes per feature. We can accept a customer-provided mapping CSV to start, then iterate on heuristics.

nina_pm: Good point. We'll ask OptiHealth to supply a feature->routes mapping for beta. That reduces instrumentation scope.

derek_infra: On telemetry side, we need to ensure token counts and model_id are captured on every request. We also need a lightweight feature_tag string in the envelope for aggregator joins. Low overhead if it's optional metadata.

telemetry-bot: New flag proposal: telemetry.feature_tag optional string. Default: empty. Will be indexed for orgs that enable feature-costing.

rajeev: For cost calc: cost_usd = (tokens_in + tokens_out) * price_per_token_at_request_time + ephemeral_compute_surcharge. We should decide whether to show surcharge in MVP. Might confuse finance.

cassie_ui: Keep UI simple: show "model_token_cost" and an optional toggle "show infra surcharge". Finance can toggle it on.

omar_se: Trace correlation: rather than full payload sampling, we can emit an error_flag and span_id on failure. On-demand sampling triggered when customer clicks a point. That avoids storing lots of traces by default.

nina_pm: That sounds lower risk. Acceptance criteria idea: OptiHealth beta users can filter by feature, see cost/feature for last 14/30/90 days, see error rate per day, and click an error day to request up to 10 on-demand traces.

derek_infra: We need guardrails: on-demand trace requests count against a per-org budget and are rate-limited. Also need a mechanism to anonymize PII before storing traces.

rajeev: Timeline: If OptiHealth supplies the feature->routes mapping, we could do a gated beta in 6 weeks for selected orgs. Production rollout maybe 10-12 weeks depending on perf signoff.

cassie_ui: I'll prototype wireframes by EOW. Will include the feature selector, stacked cost breakdown (tokens vs model vs infra), error sparkline, and an "investigate" button for traces.

telemetry-bot: Note: I'll create a feature flag entry "feature_costing_beta" and a runbook stub for on-demand-trace quota.

omar_se: Risk list to surface:
- inaccurate feature mapping for customers who share routes
- storage cost for requested traces if abused
- billing mismatch if model price changes between request and billing snapshot

nina_pm: Mitigations:
- require customer-provided mapping for beta; heuristic improvements post-beta
- implement per-org quota + auto-throttle for traces; compress traces and 30d TTL
- snapshot model price at ingestion and include price_id in telemetry event

derek_infra: Perf constraints: Tagging feature_tag should be optional and very small; test shows <=0.4% p99 CPU uplift in our alpha SDK. We'll still gate by org opt-in.

cassie_ui: CSV export columns for MVP: feature, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, model_price_usd, token_cost_usd, infra_surcharge_usd (optional), errors_count, p95_latency_ms.

omar_se: Who owns what?
- Product: nina_pm (OptiHealth contact + acceptance)
- Telemetry: rajeev (ingest changes + price snapshot)
- UI: cassie_ui (mockups + export)
- Infra: derek_infra (quotas + PII sanitization)
- Automation: telemetry-bot (flags + runbook)

nina_pm: Decision: greenlight beta with OptiHealth if they provide mapping. Phase gating: Beta=feature_tag + UI (no traces stored); Phase 2=on-demand traces + quotas; Phase 3=auto-correlation and forecasting.

rajeev: Follow-up: I'll draft the ingestion schema changes and a migration plan for older events. Posting PR early next week.

cassie_ui: I'll upload initial mockups to the design board and link them here when ready.

derek_infra: I'll draft the quota policy and TTL settings for traces; will run a cost estimate for 1k on-demand trace requests/day across 100 beta orgs.

nina_pm: Action items recap: @OptiHealth -> mapping CSV. @cassie_ui -> mockups. @rajeev -> ingest PR + price snapshot doc. @derek_infra -> quota/cost estimate. @telemetry-bot -> flag + runbook. We'll meet next Wed to review.

telemetry-bot: Meeting invite created: #observability-beta-kickoff Wed 11:00.

nina_pm: Thanks all. Filing product ticket now and adding acceptance tests in the ticket. Closing thread for daily sync.
